question: Who will be freed, having enjoyed through crores of births?
premises: But formerly this one enjoyed, bringing about this and that, through crores of births.
He will be freed by meditation-practice and the like, whoever has come by this path.
inference: Births-enjoyed becoming yields to path-gained freedom via practice.
uncertainties: Tattattāpādy segmentation unclear, this-and-that bringing presumed.
plain_english: But formerly this one enjoyed, bringing about this and that, through crores of births indeed; he will be freed by meditation-practice and the like — whoever has come by this path.
